title: Golden byte-parity: tag ordering, char-ID order, depth reuse, gradient-fill expansion
description: RESOLVED as documented decision (not code work). The byte-level gaps between our golden FLA->SWF and canonical Flash 8 (tag ordering, char-ID order, depth reuse, gradient-fill expansion, zlib stream) are semantically inert and NOT pursued — true byte-for-byte is infeasible without replicating Flash's exact tag interleaving / ID-depth allocation / gradient encoding / deflate. The achievable target, decompressed SEMANTIC parity, is met: node tools/golden-parity.mjs exits 0 on golden + golden-v2 with these listed as KNOWN-GAP. Documented in CLAUDE.md ('Golden FLA->SWF parity' section) and the harness ledger. Reopen only if a downstream consumer needs exact bytes.
